how_to_apply: Visit the official Northeast Frontier Railway website: www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in
Navigate to the "Recruitment against Sports Quota" section and locate Notification No. 04/2026.
Register with a valid, active mobile number and email ID, as all communication will be sent through these channels.
Fill in the online application form with personal, educational and sports achievement details.
Upload the required documents, photograph and signature as per the specified size and format.
Pay the applicable application fee online.
Review all entered details carefully and submit the application before 24 August 2026.
Save a copy/printout of the submitted application for future reference. Do not send the printout by post.
important_instructions: There is no caste-based reservation in this recruitment. However, SC, ST and OBC-NCL candidates must still submit prescribed caste certificates (Annexure-C and Annexure-D) and EWS candidates must submit an EWS certificate (Annexure-E) for record purposes, where applicable.

Only online applications are accepted; applications or certificates sent by post will not be considered. Candidates will be considered only for the specific event/position/game for which they have the recognized sports norms. Candidates having achievement norms for a higher grade pay post are also eligible for lower grade pay posts of the same or a related event. No TA/DA/accommodation is provided for appearing in trials; candidates must bring their own kit and arrange their own stay for 2-3 days if required. Selected candidates must undergo a probation period of two years and sign a Service Bond to serve at least 5 years in Indian Railways. Selected candidates must qualify the prescribed medical examination for the post. Candidates already employed in government service, PSUs or recognized banks must submit a No Objection Certificate. NF Railway has not appointed any agent or coaching centre; candidates should beware of touts and job racketeers. Applications not fulfilling any of the notified terms and conditions are liable to be summarily rejected. Any legal dispute is subject to the jurisdiction of the Central Administrative Tribunal, Guwahati.

Candidates who are Class 12th pass can also explore more 12th Pass Government Jobs and Railway Recruitment 2026 opportunities. Those interested in similar openings can check Sports Quota Recruitment notifications from other Railway zones. content_sections.heading: Northeast Frontier Railway Sports Quota Vacancy Details 2026-27
content_sections.text: A total of 56 vacancies - NF Railway has notified 56 posts against Sports Quota. There is no community-wise reservation in this recruitment; vacancies are distributed by pay level, sport discipline, gender category and playing position/event as shown below. Selected candidates will be posted in the Alipurduar, Katihar, Rangiya, Lumding or Tinsukia Divisions, or at the NF Railway Headquarter, depending on the requirement of sports and vacancy availability.

rows.divisions: 25 (5 each for Alipurduar, Katihar, Rangiya, Lumding, Tinsukia)

content_sections.heading: NF Railway Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must be citizens of India and satisfy the educational qualification, age limit and minimum sports achievement norms prescribed for the pay level and event they are applying for. For Technician-III posts filled against Sports Quota, the minimum qualification is Class 10th pass; the training period is 3 years unless the candidate holds a relevant ITI qualification, in which case it is reduced to 6 months. Candidates for both Level 3/2 and Level 1 posts must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on 01 January 2027 . The notification does not specify age relaxation details for reserved categories; candidates should refer to the official notification or website for any updates on this. Candidates must be active players whose achievements fall within the immediately preceding two financial years, and only achievements in recognized events held on or after 01 April 2024 will be considered. Sport-specific norms (Archery, Athletics, Badminton/Table Tennis rankings, Basketball, Boxing, Cricket, Football, Golf rankings, Power Lifting, Volleyball and Weightlifting weight categories) are laid out in detail in the official notification. Candidates should check the exact criteria applicable to their event before applying.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: Passed Class 12th (+2 stage) or equivalent from a Government-recognized Board/Council/Institution
Passed Class 10th (Matriculation) or ITI or equivalent, or National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) granted by NCVT

rows.minimum_sports_norms: Represented the country in Category-B events, OR 3rd position or better in Category-C events/Senior-Youth-Junior National Championships/National Games/All India Inter University Championships, OR 1st position in Federation Cup (Senior)

Represented the country in Category-C events, OR 3rd position or better in Federation Cup (Senior), OR represented a state with at least 8th position in Senior National Championships (except marathon/cross-country)

content_sections.heading: NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27 Salary
content_sections.text: The notification specifies posts under Level-1, Level-2 and Level-3 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix (corresponding to erstwhile Grade Pay Rs. 1800, 1900 and 2000). The exact in-hand monthly salary figures are not mentioned in the official notification; candidates can refer to the applicable Railway Pay Matrix for these levels for detailed pay information.

content_sections.text: Candidates who appear for the selection trial are entitled to a partial refund of the application fee (after deduction of banking and other charges); bank details must be furnished in the online application to receive the refund. Minority (for fee exemption purposes) includes Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Zoroastrians (Parsis) and Jains. content_sections.heading: NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on a 100-mark merit list comprising a Sports Trial and an Interview. Candidates scoring 25 or more out of 40 in the Trial are declared "FIT" and proceed to the Interview stage; those below 25 are declared "NOT FIT" and are not assessed further. Interviews are normally held on the same day as the trial, or the next day at the latest. For educational qualification, 6 marks are given for meeting the minimum qualification; higher qualifications attract higher marks. Minimum qualifying marks: 65 for Level-3 and Level-2 posts, and 60 for Level-1 posts. In case of a tie in marks, preference is given to the younger candidate.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 24 August 2026. Applications opened on 25 July 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: There are 56 vacancies across Level-1, Level-2 and Level-3 posts in 13 sports disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 25 years of age as on 01 January 2027 for both Level-1 and Level-2/3 posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Class 12th pass is required for Level-2/3 posts, and Class 10th pass, ITI or NAC is required for Level-1 posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Rs. 500/- for General category candidates and Rs. 250/- for SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Women, Minority and EBC candidates, with partial refund available to those who appear for the trial.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply through the official website www.nfr.indianrailways.gov.in under the Recruitment against Sports Quota section.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a Sports Trial (40 marks) followed by an Interview (60 marks), for a total of 100 marks, subject to minimum qualifying marks of 65 (Level-2/3) or 60 (Level-1).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any caste-based reservation in NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: No, there is no reservation for any community in this recruitment, though SC/ST/OBC-NCL/EWS candidates must still submit the prescribed certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Where will selected candidates be posted in NFR Sports Quota Recruitment 2026-27?
faq.answer: Selected candidates may be posted in the Alipurduar, Katihar, Rangiya, Lumding or Tinsukia Divisions, or at the NF Railway Headquarter in Maligaon, Guwahati.
